item.title: Budget 2026: Govt accepts Finance Commission 16 recommendations
item.description: Recommendations aim to rebalance Centre–state fund sharing, reduce distance criterion and boost funding for panchayats, cities and disaster management

item.title: Union Budget 2026 proposes Rs 10,000 crore push for biopharma sector
item.description: Budget 2025 proposes a Rs 10,000 crore Biopharma Shakti initiative to boost manufacturing, clinical trials and make India a global biopharma hub

item.title: Union Budget 2026 unveils India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, boosts outlay
item.description: Budget announces India Semiconductor Mission 2.0, raising electronics components outlay to Rs 40,000 crore to strengthen design, manufacturing and supply chains

item.title: Budget 2026: MSME sector gets Rs 10,000 cr boost
item.description: Government to revive 200 industrial clusters and boost liquidity through TReDS to enhance credit access and manufacturing competitiveness for MSMEs

item.title: Union Budget 2026 lays out big infra push with capex, waterways focus
item.description: Budget proposes Rs12.2 lakh crore capex, infra risk guarantee fund, new freight corridors and a major push for inland waterways and logistics

item.title: Budget eases tax compliance, cuts TCS and extends ITR timelines
item.description: Budget announces tax compliance relief, lower TCS on overseas tour packages, extended ITR revision window and simplified rules for NRI property sales

item.title: Budget 2026-27: Fiscal deficit estimated at 4.3 pc of GDP for FY27
item.description: Centre to adopt debt-to-GDP ratio as primary fiscal indicator from coming fiscal year

item.title: Budget 2026-27 unveils high-speed rail, freight corridors push
item.description: Union Budget 2026 proposes seven high-speed rail corridors, new freight links, national waterways and eco-tourism initiatives to drive sustainable growth

item.title: Budget 2026–27 gives a Yuva Shakti, AI driven push for India’s future
item.description: Sitharaman unveils sweeping reforms to empower India’s youth, through education, skills, and technology, positioning them as cornerstone of Viksit Bharat 2047

item.title: Sitharaman unveils major tourism push in Budget 2026-27; eyes job generation
item.description: Government to develop 15 cultural sites and five medical tourism hubs while launching seaplane incentives and seven high-speed rail corridors to boost growth
